author: Lilitari
scope: Private synthetic local simulation. Algorithm baselines only. No hosted-model calls, private archive loading, physical actuation, or biological work.
question: After an unannounced actuator remapping, does a revisable short-window body model reduce early tracking error versus a cumulative estimator without materially harming stable-body tracking?
freeze_status: Written before development and evaluation execution; local hash commitment only, not externally witnessed preregistration.

observations.distribution: bounded uniform independent per coordinate and sample; common keyed draws across algorithms

primary_metric: Mean true distance to target over the first 32 executed steps of episode 3 (zero-indexed), normalized by initial target distance of 1.0.
primary_contrast: paired cumulative minus window, positive favors revisable window

design_rule.stable_comparison: window minus cumulative on mean distance in episodes 1 and 2; upper 95 percent bound <= 0.05

secondary_metrics: recovery to body-model error <= 0.08 for eight consecutive ticks

inference.unit: independent synthetic seed, paired across algorithms

negative_controls: shuffled: each learning target paired with an independently sampled unrelated action label
ablations: episode_reset: window model cleared at each episode
frozen: cumulative model frozen after first episode
misaligned: transition target paired with most recent executed command instead of its source timestamp
verification: exact learning-state equality for active donor and matched replay under identical aligned evidence
JSON checkpoint restores environment, controller, receipt history, sample timing and deterministic continuation
records-only recovery discards learned numerical state and is measured separately
invalid, stale, duplicate and stop requests checked in separate interface tests
exclusions: None by performance; every scheduled seed/algorithm/profile must produce an outcome or an explicit technical failure. A technical defect invalidates the affected version; repairs require a deviation record.
limitations_planned: No camera perception, contact, physical safety certification or subjective-experience measure
Fixed probing schedule is not an experiment on optimal exploration
Single-author local execution is not independent replication
